drums.description: Industrial metal with heavy electronic influences, Distorted electric guitar plays a repetitive, palm-muted chugging riff in 4/4 time at 100 BPM, A gritty, overdriven synth bass doubles the guitar line, The drum kit features a processed, punchy kick and a metallic snare with a short decay, High-frequency industrial percussion hits and mechanical clangs occur on the off-beats, A resonant, low-pass filtered synth sweep rises periodically, The track maintains a consistent, driving rhythmic intensity without melodic variation, Key of E minor Publish

bass.description: Industrial techno track at 135 BPM in the key of G minor, The arrangement centers on a distorted, resonant kick drum with a long decay that functions as a sub-bass, A metallic, percussive synth sequence with a high-pass filter and short decay provides a rhythmic counterpoint, A gritty, overdriven sawtooth bassline enters with a syncopated 16th-note pattern, High-frequency white noise bursts and a sharp, digital clap emphasize the backbeat, A resonant, acid-style synth lead with automated cutoff frequency and resonance creates evolving textures, The track features heavy parallel compression and a dark, industrial reverb on the percussion elements Publish
